service.en: Cancel a domestic worker's employment contract
service.ar: إلغاء عقد عمل عامل خدمة منزلية
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کا ملازمت معاہدہ منسوخ کرنا

about: End the employment contract of a domestic worker, inside or outside the country.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Employer's passport and ID card must be valid
Resident employers or investors need a valid residence visa
documents: Employer's passport copy (citizens include the unified number page)
Worker's passport copy and ID card
Resident employer's or investor's residence visa
fees: 85.75 AED in Dubai inside the country; 185.75 AED outside it
Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
